permissions.name: network
permissions.desc: Connects to the PACT Cloud Relay over HTTPS and WSS for ephemeral 16kHz speech-to-text, Notion contradiction detection, and Telegram commitment locking.

permissions.name: g2-microphone

permissions.name: phone-microphone
permissions.desc: Provides fallback 16kHz PCM audio capture when running without G2 glasses microphone input.
